name: ProLMSCore Migrator
author: synantixlabs

sections.description:
ProLMSCore Migrator makes one package (a ZIP file) with everything your students need to keep learning on a ProLMSCore academy:

  • Courses, sections and lessons, with their text, video links and attachments.
  • Quizzes with their questions (single and multiple choice, true/false, fill in the blanks, matching, ordering, open answers). Question types without an equivalent are converted to the closest one and listed in the import report.
  • Students, their enrollments, completed lessons, quiz results and completion dates, with the real dates (never the date of the migration).
  • Optionally (off by default), the password hashes, so students can log in with the password they already use. A password hash is not the password, but anyone holding the package could try to guess weak passwords from it: include them only if you upload the package yourself right away.

It only reads. It never changes your posts, settings or the tables of your learning plugin. The package is kept in a private folder outside your public website when the server allows it (otherwise in a folder with a random name inside the site, blocked by a .htaccess), can be downloaded only by an administrator, is deleted right after you download it, and in any case after one hour.

Supported sources

  • Tutor LMS (checked with the free version 4.2.0).
  • LifterLMS (checked with the free version 10.3.2).
  • LearnPress (checked with the free version 4.4.13).
  • LearnDash (it has no free version: the adapter follows its documented data layout and was checked with simulated data; please report anything that does not travel well).

What does not travel

Payments, orders, coupons and prices; certificate designs; forums; live meetings; and video files uploaded to your own site (the import report lists them so you can upload them again). Video links (YouTube, Vimeo and others) do travel.

Privacy

The package holds personal data of your students (names, emails and, if you choose, password hashes). This plugin does not send anything anywhere: you download the file and upload it yourself to your academy. Delete it when you are done. Before moving your students’ data, make sure you are allowed to, and tell them if the law or your terms require it.

Where the package is stored

By default the package is written OUTSIDE your public website — in the server’s temporary folder, or one level above the WordPress directory — in a folder with a long random name and owner-only permissions (0700 folder, 0600 files). There is no web address to it at all, so a leaked or guessed URL cannot reach it. The download always goes through the plugin, for logged-in administrators only (capability and nonce checked). Each package is deleted right after you download it, in any case after one hour, and when you make a new one; the folder is removed when you uninstall.

Only if the server has no writable folder outside the public area does the plugin fall back to a folder with a random name inside wp-content/uploads, with its own index.php, .htaccess and web.config. On Apache the .htaccess blocks it; on Nginx (where .htaccess does nothing) the random folder name is what keeps it private, and the plugin screen warns you about this. You can always choose any folder with the prolmscore_migrator_private_dir filter: return an absolute path your server does not serve. Password hashes are off by default; turn them on only if you will upload and delete the package right away.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin on the WordPress site where your courses are now (with your learning plugin active).
  2. Go to Tools → ProLMSCore Migrator.
  3. Choose what to include and click “Make package”.
  4. Download the package and upload it in your ProLMSCore academy: Studio → Import → “ProLMSCore package”.

Large sites can use the command line: wp prolmscore-migrator export --output=package.zip (options: --source, --courses, --no-people, --passwords, --no-files).
sections.faq:
Will my current site change?

No. The plugin only reads data. You can keep using your site as before.

Can I import the same package twice?

Yes. The academy recognizes what it already imported and does not duplicate it.

My learning plugin is on the same WordPress where I installed ProLMSCore. Do I need this?

No. In that case the academy Studio can read your courses directly (Studio → Import).
sections.changelog:
0.1.5

  • Security: by default the package is now stored OUTSIDE your public website (the server’s temp folder, or one level above WordPress) under a random name with owner-only permissions, so there is no web address to it at all. Only if nothing outside the web root is writable does it fall back to a random folder in uploads (blocked by .htaccess, and the screen warns you). The download still goes only through the plugin (administrators only, with a nonce).
  • Security: the package is deleted right after you download it, and the automatic expiry is reduced from 24 hours to one hour. Command-line exports write the package with owner-only permissions.

0.1.4

  • Fix: wp prolmscore-migrator export now creates its working folder before writing the package, so exports that copy no files (content-only courses, courses whose media are only external video links, or --no-files) no longer fail with “The package could not be written”. The admin screen was never affected.
  • Fix: the --no-people and --no-files command-line flags are accepted again (the command synopsis declared them in a form WP-CLI rejected).

0.1.3

  • Security: the export folder now has a long random name (not a fixed, guessable one), so it stays private even where .htaccess is ignored (Nginx). A new prolmscore_migrator_private_dir filter can move the folder outside the web root. The download still goes only through the plugin, for administrators. The readme explains the Nginx case; password hashes remain off by default.
  • Performance: on older LearnDash courses (no course builder), the outline is now read with a few batched queries instead of one query per lesson and topic.

0.1.2

  • Security: every database query is built with $wpdb->prepare(), including table names (%i) and the lists of IDs and keys (one placeholder per value, in batches of 500). No value is written into SQL by hand anymore.
  • Translations are no longer shipped inside the plugin (WordPress.org provides them) and the plugin no longer calls load_plugin_textdomain().
  • Nonce checks are explicit in each admin action; an unknown error code in the page address no longer raises a PHP notice.
  • New uninstall routine: removes the plugin’s two options, its daily clean-up and its private folder (on every site of a network).
  • Requires WordPress 6.2 or later.

0.1.1

  • Password hashes are off by default, with a clear warning. Texts say “password hashes” instead of “encrypted passwords”. New --passwords command line flag.

0.1.0

  • First version: Tutor LMS, LifterLMS, LearnPress and LearnDash sources; admin page and command line export.

short_description: Export your courses, students and their progress from Tutor LMS, LifterLMS, LearnPress or LearnDash into one package for a ProLMSCore academy.
